prose.name: Bounty: Crimson Fleet Raiders on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Crimson Fleet drove the crew off the <Place> and are stripping its machinery for parts. Their leader is the one keeping them there. If the leader goes down, the rest won't hold the site for long.
prose.card: Local Contract. Crimson Fleet raiders hold the <Place> on <Planet>. Remove their leader. Payment on contract completion.

broadcast: Raiders took our site, and they're pulling the machinery apart. We got out with what we could carry. Their leader's keeping them there. Take the leader down.

beats.objective: Defeat the raid leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The raid leader at the <Place> is dead. Whoever's left won't hold the site for long without them.
say: That's the leader down. The rest won't hang about now. Good work, mate.
